sections.title: Web Projects
sections.subtitle: Some of my best Web Projects

projects.title: UKM IBAF UPI
projects.desc: Full-stack fitness platform with a member dashboard, training program management, and progress tracking for a campus fitness community.
projects.detail: A comprehensive web platform for UKM IBAF (Ideal Body and Fitness) UPI with full-stack features. The system includes: (1) a landing page and community profile with an activity timeline, (2) a backend for managing training programs with exercise guidance, target weight, and member progress tracking, (3) user authentication and role-based access for admin, trainer, and member, (4) an interactive dashboard for monitoring member progress with statistical charts, (5) customizable training programs based on fitness level, (6) a gallery and documentation for community events, and (7) a responsive design that works on all devices. Technologies used: React, Firebase Realtime Database, and Bootstrap for a consistent and modern UI.

projects.title: GYM UPI
projects.desc: Information and service management website for GYM UPI with class schedules, member registration, and real-time promo updates.
projects.detail: GYM UPI is a web platform designed to digitize campus gym services, from facility information to the member registration flow. Its main features include: (1) a catalog of gym services and facilities, (2) class and workout schedules that are easy to monitor, (3) an online member registration form, (4) a page for promotions and latest announcements, (5) an admin dashboard to manage content, schedules, and registrant data, and (6) a responsive interface that is comfortable to use on both desktop and mobile devices.
